name: cuttle
description: Cuttle, the AI screen recorder that edits itself: record your screen or Claude Code at work, get a polished demo video.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/export/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/export/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p packages/recorder/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc -p skill/tsconfig.json
scripts.export:build: vite build --config packages/export/electron/vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config packages/export/electron/vite.page.config.ts && node packages/motion-kit/scripts/copy.mjs packages/export/dist/motion-kit
scripts.cli:build: vite build --config apps/cli/vite.config.ts && vite build --config packages/export/electron/vite.page.config.ts --outDir ../../../apps/cli/dist/export-page && node packages/recorder/native/build-macos.mjs apps/cli/dist && node packages/recorder/native/build-windows.mjs apps/cli/dist && node packages/motion-kit/scripts/copy.mjs apps/cli/dist/motion-kit
scripts.cli:check: pnpm cli:build && vitest run --mode cli apps/cli/test/electron.check.test.ts
scripts.app:check: pnpm app:build:js && pnpm cli:build && vitest run --mode app apps/desktop/test/app.check.test.ts
scripts.app:build: pnpm app:build:js && pnpm cli:build && node apps/desktop/scripts/package.mjs && vitest run --mode build apps/desktop/test/build.check.test.ts
